Interface Graph

  • Method Details

    • addVertex

      void addVertex(String vertex)
      Adds a vertex to the graph. If the vertex already exists, the operation is ignored.
      Parameters:
      vertex - the vertex to be added to the graph

    • removeVertex

      void removeVertex(String vertex)
      Removes a vertex from the graph along with all edges incident to it. If the vertex does not exist in the graph, the operation is ignored
      Parameters:
      vertex - the vertex to be removed from the graph

    • addEdge

      void addEdge(String source, String destination)
      Adds a directed edge from the source vertex to the destination vertex. If the edge already exists, the operation is ignored.
      Parameters:
      source - the source vertex of the edge
      destination - the destination vertex of the edge

    • removeEdge

      void removeEdge(String source, String destination)
      Removes a directed edge between the specified vertices. If the edge does not exist, the operation is ignored.
      Parameters:
      source - the source vertex of the edge to remove
      destination - the destination vertex of the edge to remove

    • getNeighbors

      List<String> getNeighbors(String vertex)
      Returns a list of all neighbors of a vertex.
      Parameters:
      vertex - the vertex for which to find neighbors
      Returns:
      a list of neighboring vertices

    • readFromFile

      void readFromFile(String filename) throws IOException
      Reads the graph from a file and replaces the current graph structure.
      Parameters:
      filename - the path to the file to read from
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs while reading the file
      SecurityException - if read access to the file is denied

    • getVertices

      Set<String> getVertices()
      Returns a set of all vertices currently in the graph.
      Returns:
      a set containing all vertices in the graph, empty if the graph has no vertices

    • getEdges

      Set<Edge> getEdges()
      Returns a set of all edges currently in the graph.
      Returns:
      a set containing all edges in the graph, empty if the graph has no edges

      Returns the number of vertices currently in the graph.
      Returns:

    • getEdgeCount

      int getEdgeCount()
      Returns the number of edges currently in the graph.
      Returns:
      the number of edges in the graph

    • hasVertex

      boolean hasVertex(String vertex)
      Checks whether a vertex exists in the graph.
      Parameters:
      vertex - the vertex to check for existence in the graph
      Returns:
      true if the vertex exists in the graph, false otherwise

    • hasEdge

      boolean hasEdge(String source, String destination)
      Checks whether a directed edge exists from the source vertex to the destination vertex.
      Parameters:
      source - the source vertex to check
      destination - the destination vertex to check
      Returns:
      true if the edge exists, false if the edge doesn't exist or either vertex doesn't exist in the graph

    • topologicalSort

      List<String> topologicalSort()
      Performs topological sorting of the graph vertices using Kahn's algorithm.
      Returns:
      a list of vertices in topological order (linear ordering)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the graph contains cycles
